text: APPROVE: `InScript` is now just two `if`s that call three helpers, and the extracted loops keep the original order and logic, so behaviour is unchanged. The helpers score about 9 or less each. I couldn't see the types of `keyframes`, `guards` and `sites` in the surrounding code, so I'm assuming the new parameter types (`IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`, `List<Site>`) match them and the build stays clean.
